name: TeamStarWolf - Threat Group: APT41 (G0096)
description: ATT&CK-documented techniques attributed to APT41 (G0096; aliases: Wicked Panda, Brass Typhoon, BARIUM). Sourced directly from MITRE's intrusion-set to technique 'uses' relationships in the bundled ATT&CK v16 data - MITRE's own attribution, not a curated TeamStarWolf mapping. Every row is documented group use (score 100). Absence of a technique does not mean the group cannot use it; it means MITRE has not documented it.
